finding: Program RED-pass and precheck paths call ProgramStore.MarkDone after two passing preimplementation tests. Passing tests or existence of a named file cannot prove new delivered implementation; continuation can skip unimplemented dependent work. completeGoapProgramMilestone also accepts labels/declared files at its own boundary; inspect actual landed commit and verification before retaining completion.
desired_behavior: Repeated preimplementation passes require review and hold dependent milestones; verified completion retains real delivery evidence; unsupported historical red-pass completions remain visible for review.
